source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of annihilation reactions with Example 19.4 (PDF 151-152, printed 147-148).

blocks.text: Positron-electron pair ka annihilation hum pichhle chapter mein parh chuke hain. Asal mein annihilation tab hota hai jab koi particle aur us ka antiparticle ek doosre ke qareeb aate hain: dono khatam ho jate hain aur un ka mass-energy photons ban jata hai. Is amal mein mass-energy aur momentum dono conserve rehte hain.

Elementary particles ki tehqeeq ke liye bohat zyada energy chahiye. Is liye particles ko un ki rest mass energy par takrane ke bajaye roshni ki speed ke qareeb tak tez kar ke takraya jata hai. CERN ke Large Hadron Collider (LHC) mein protons aur bhari nuclei roshni ki speed ke qareeb takraye jate hain taake shuru ki kainaat (early universe) jaise halaat ban saken. TeV darje ki energy wali yeh takkaren early universe ko samajhne mein madad deti hain. Aisi takkaron mein electro-weak force ke mediator particles W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons, jin ki peshgoi Prof. Abdus Salam ne ki thi, daryaft hue; saath top aur bottom quarks bhi mile, aur sab se ahem Higgs boson July 2012 mein daryaft hua.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke LHC mein proton aur antiproton takraye jate hain. LHC protons ko protons se (aur lead jaise bhari nuclei ko aapas mein) takrata hai; proton-antiproton takkaren pehle CERN ke SPS aur Fermilab ke Tevatron mein hui thin (W aur Z bosons 1983 mein SPS par mile). Kitab W⁻ ko 'W⁻¹' bhi likhti hai.

blocks.alt: Takkar ke nuqte par W/Z boson, jis ke gird chhote zarrat bikhre hain, aik W/Z boson aur Higgs boson h mein batta hai. W/Z se quark q aur antiquark q-bar, aur h se b aur b-bar quarks bante hain. Har quark zarrat ki aik bauchhar mein khatam hota hai: Jet 1, Jet 2, Jet 3, Jet 4.
blocks.caption: Aap ki maloomat ke liye: p+ aur p- ki takkar ka khaaka (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Takkar se W/Z boson banta hai jo aik W/Z aur Higgs boson (h) mein badalta hai. W/Z quark aur antiquark (q, q-bar) mein, aur h bottom quark ke jore (b, b-bar) mein badalta hai; har quark zarrat ki aik 'jet' banata hai jise detector pakarta hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Kitab CMS detector mein 7 TeV proton-proton takkar ki tasveer dikhati hai jis mein 100 se zyada charged particles bane.

blocks.title: Example 19.4
blocks.problem: Electron-positron pair ke annihilation mein nikalne wale gamma ray photons ki energy nikalein.
steps: Positron ka mass = electron ka mass = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg
Einstein ki mass-energy relation: E = 2mc² = 2 × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)²
blocks.answer: Do γ-ray photons nikalte hain, har ek 0.51 MeV ka, mukhalif simton mein, taake momentum conserve rahe.

blocks.alt: Electron e- aur positron e+ aik doosre ki taraf aa kar khatam hote hain; takkar ke nuqte se do gamma photons, har aik 0.51 MeV, mukhalif simton (oopar aur neeche) mein nikalte hain; E = 2moc^2 = 1.02 MeV.
blocks.caption: Electron-positron annihilation (asal khaaka; kitab mein is ki koi shakal nahi).

blocks.text: Jism ke andar annihilation se nikalne wale gamma-ray photons itni energy rakhte hain ke jism se bahar nikal aate hain, is liye unhein jism ke bahar detectors pakad sakte hain. Positron emission tomography (PET) isi par kaam karti hai: positron kharij karne wala tracer jism mein dala jata hai; har positron jaldi kisi electron se mil kar khatam hota hai, aur mukhalif simton mein jane wali 0.51 MeV ki do gamma rays mareez ke gird detectors ki ring pakad leti hai.

blocks.prompt: Electron-positron annihilation ke do photons mukhalif simton mein kyun nikalte hain?
blocks.explanation: Annihilation se pehle pair ka kul momentum taqreeban zero hai. Momentum conserve rakhne ke liye do photons ka momentum barabar aur ulta hona chahiye: barabar energy (har ek 0.51 MeV) aur mukhalif simten.

items: Annihilation: particle + antiparticle → photons; mass-energy aur momentum conserve.
e⁻ + e⁺ → do gamma rays, har ek 0.51 MeV, mukhalif simton mein (E = 2mc² = 1.02 MeV).
LHC (proton-proton): W, Z bosons (Abdus Salam ki peshgoi), Higgs boson (2012); PET annihilation istemal karti hai.
